name: Seachem Prime
description: Concentrated water conditioner: removes chlorine + chloramine and temporarily detoxifies ammonia, nitrite, and nitrate. A husbandry safety additive, not a fertiliser — no nutrient `contributes`.
notes: Label dose ~5 ml (1 capful) per 200 L at water change. Ammonia detox is temporary (~24-48 h) — it converts ammonia to a non-toxic, still bio-available form.
